幻象收益：审计自我完善Phantom Gains: Auditing Self-Improvement
针对测量的零点Against a Measured Null

Cheng Xu    Nan Yan    Liming Chen Affiliation: University College Dublin Georgia Institute of Technology Dalian University of Technologycheng.xu1@ucdconnect.ie, nan.yan@gatech.edu, tahar.kechadi@ucd.ie    M-Tahar Kechadi
摘要Abstract

一个语言模型是否已经自我改进，越来越多地不再通过平均准确度来评判，而是通过它在哪些个别问题上得到和失去了来判断。跟踪这些转变意味着区分两个噪声估计，使它们容易受到测量伪影的影响。审核三轮排名Whether a language model has improved itself is increasingly judged not by mean accuracy but by which individual problems it gains and loses. Tracking these transitions means differencing two noisy estimates, leaving them vulnerable to measurement artifacts. Auditing three rounds of rank-3232在 Qwen3-8B 上针对通过相同管道推送的冻结控制进行 LoRA 自我训练，我们发现了七个测量失败，每个失败都在其控制缺失时颠倒了报告的发现。有几种是标准做法。建立在单个贪婪解码之上的分类账会在未经训练的模型上产生能力变化，这很大程度上是推理批处理的产物；将采集与锐化分开的扩展统计数据为同一模型分配了LoRA self-training on Qwen3-8B against a frozen control pushed through the identical pipeline, we identify seven measurement failures, each of which inverts a reported finding when its control is absent. Several are standard practice. A ledger built on a single greedy decode manufactures capability changes on an untrained model, largely an artifact of inference batching; the expansion statistic separating acquisition from sharpening assigns that same model a rate of0.2800.280。自然阈值修复无法复制：通过此类设计已包含的冻结比较进行估计，其空值保持非零。我们将其替换为针对错误发现率控制下的合并基线的针对每个问题的精确测试，该测试在任何保留的重复中检测不到任何内容，并且在多重测试规则、错误率和池大小下保持不变。应用于在流、容量和评估方面匹配的武器梯子时，审计发现外部蒸馏改善了基本模型很少遇到的问题，而三种形式的自我训练则无法解决；回归拒绝这种不对称性作为蒸馏更大的总体增益的副产品（. The natural threshold repair does not survive replication: estimated across the frozen comparisons such a design already contains, its null stays non-zero. We replace it with a per-problem exact test against a pooled baseline under false-discovery-rate control, which detects nothing on any held-out replicate and is unchanged under the multiple-testing rule, error rate and pool size. Applied to a ladder of arms matched in stream, volume and evaluation, the audit finds that external distillation improves problems the base model rarely reaches while three forms of self-training do not; a regression rejects this asymmetry as a by-product of distillation’s larger overall gain (p<10−8p<10^{-8}）。对于基本模型从未达到的更小的问题集，证据是不确定的，而自我训练会以远高于测量下限的速率破坏在基线上解决的问题。因此，转换级审计需要为其报告的每个统计数据单独测量零值：不需要新实验的零值，从基线复制已经拥有的多臂研究，尽管不是像大多数人拥有的那样少。代码和评估工件可在). On the far smaller set of problems the base model never reaches, the evidence is inconclusive, while self-training corrupts problems solved at baseline at rates well above the measured floor. Transition-level auditing therefore requires a separately measured null for every statistic it reports: nulls that cost no new experiments, built from baseline replicates a multi-arm study already owns, though not from as few as most possess. Code and evaluation artifacts are available athttps://github.com/chengxuphd/phantom-gains.

1 简介Introduction

无需新的监督即可自我改进的语言模型将是一件相当重要的事情，并且越来越多的方法家族准确地报告了这一点A language model that improves itself without new supervision would be a considerable thing, and a growing family of methods reports exactly that(14; 60)。 STAR根据自己正确的理由进行微调. STaR fine-tunes on its own correct rationales(77); TTRL 以多数票超过其自己的样本来更换标签; TTRL replaces labels with a majority vote over its own samples(82);更精细的计划会产生自己的课程; more elaborate schemes generate their own curricula(79; 7; 29)或学习编辑自己的权重or learn to edit their own weights(83).

提供的证据曾经是一个数字：之前的准确性，之后的准确性The evidence offered used to be a single number: accuracy before, accuracy after(3)。现在人们普遍认为这是不够的，因为聚合无法区分模型新学会解决的问题和它在好的情况下已经可以解决的问题. That is now widely accepted to be insufficient, since an aggregate cannot distinguish a problem the model newly learned to solve from one it could already solve on a good day(71; 75)，也不显示平均值上升时损失了什么。因此，第二代分析已转向单个问题，跟踪哪些问题进入和离开模型的可达集, nor show what was lost while the mean rose. A second generation of analyses has therefore moved to individual problems, tracking which enter and leave a model’s reachable set(72; 65; 41)并计算那些在自我训练中被摧毁的人and counting those destroyed under self-training(35; 70).

这是正确的举动，但它产生了一个新问题。转变是两个估计之间的差异，每个估计都带有采样误差，而感兴趣的事件恰好位于误差最严重的地方。在三个评估集上审核 Qwen3-8B 的自我训练，我们隔离This is the right move, and it creates a new problem. A transition is a difference between two estimates, each carrying sampling error, and the events of interest sit exactly where that error bites hardest. Auditing self-training on Qwen3-8B across three evaluation sets, we isolate七seven测量失败，在缺乏控制的情况下，每一次都会产生自信且错误的结论（图measurement failures, each of which produces a confident and wrong conclusion wherever its control is absent (Figure1）。两种是标准做法，一种是对另一种的修正。). Two are standard practice, and one lies inside the correction for another.

单个解码不是一种状态。A single decode is not a state.批处理下的零温度解码不是确定性的Temperature-zero decoding is not deterministic under batching(22)，因此每个问题建立在一个贪婪样本上的分类账给出了一个未经训练的模型，对其自身进行重新评估，, so a ledger built on one greedy sample per problem gives an untrained model, re-evaluated against itself,66明显的学习和apparent learnings and99明显的腐败行为。腐败与学习的比率为apparent corruptions. That is a corruption-to-learning ratio of1.51.5：这篇文献报道的令人震惊的结果是无中生有的。序列化请求可以消除四分之三的翻转并确认机制，但不是全部：即使一次一个请求，冻结的模型也会发生变化: the shape of the alarming result this literature reports, manufactured out of nothing. Serializing the requests removes three-quarters of those flips and confirms the mechanism, but not all of them: even one request at a time, a frozen model changes2%2\%其贪婪的判决。of its greedy verdicts.

贡献。Contributions.

(i) 过渡级审计的七种测量失败模式，每种模式都在推翻结论的运行中得到证明；最后一个出现在第二个的修正中（第(i) Seven measurement failure modes for transition-level audits, each demonstrated on a run where it reverses a conclusion; the last arises inside the correction for the second (Section4）。 (ii) 扩展统计量的无阈值替代，我们测量其零值而不是假设，并且其比较经受多重测试规则、错误率和池大小（第 1 节）). (ii) A threshold-free replacement for the expansion statistic, whose null we measure rather than assume and whose comparisons survive the multiple-testing rule, the error rate and the pool size (Section4.2）。 (iii) 使测量的零点几乎自由的观察，即每个臂的检查点). (iii) The observation that makes measured nulls nearly free, namely that every arm’s checkpoint00是对未经训练的模型的独立评估，以及模型变得值得信赖的重复次数，这比三臂研究拥有的要多。 (iv) 一个过渡账本，具有特定于基准的噪声基底和效应大小核算，将阈值闪烁与实际能力损失分开，以及一个政策梯度臂，三个种子在模型何时崩溃方面存在分歧，但并不认为它确实崩溃（第 1 节）is an independent evaluation of the untrained model, together with the replicate count at which one becomes trustworthy, which is more than a three-arm study owns. (iv) A transition ledger with a benchmark-specific noise floor and effect-size accounting that separates threshold flicker from real capability loss, and a policy-gradient arm on which three seeds disagree about when the model collapses but not that it does (Section5).

6 讨论Discussion

报告标准。A reporting standard.

下面是七种做法，每种做法都在此处捕获了相反的结果：report a no-op control forSeven practices follow, each of which caught an inverted result here: report a no-op control for每个every统计和statistic and有间隔with an interval;使控制器的设计与手臂的设计相匹配；通过求解率估计器而不是单个解码来定义正确性；与任何阈值扩展统计相比，更喜欢针对合并基线进行每个问题的测试；每个检查点的日志生成长度；来自先前功率分析的尺寸转变比较；并报告至少三个在相同问题上得分的训练种子。正如我们自己的政策梯度部门所表明的那样，第三颗种子可能会改变这一发现。其中五个不需要新的实验，而是对一项仔细研究已经保存的记录进行重新分析，但没有一个是在四个冷冻复制品上进行的，这对于读取它们时的零值来说是不够的。我们报告了大约十几个; match the control’s design to the arm’s; define correctness through a solve-rate estimator rather than a single decode; prefer a per-problem test against a pooled baseline to any thresholded expansion statistic; log generation length per checkpoint; size transition comparisons from a prior power analysis; and report at least three training seeds, scored on the same problems. As our own policy-gradient arm shows, the third seed can be the one that changes the finding. Five need no new experiments, being re-analyses of records a careful study already holds, but none of them on four frozen replicates, which is not enough for the null they would be read against. We report roughly a dozenpp-跨七种故障模式的值，并在每个系列内而不是跨它们进行修正，这是在这里说明的，而不是留下来注意（附录-values across seven failure modes and correct within each family rather than across them, which is stated here rather than left to be noticed (AppendixD.1).

结论。Conclusion.

过渡级审计是对以下事实的正确回应：准确性掩盖了自我改进模型的收益和破坏。这本身也是一个测量问题：我们隔离了七种出错的方法，其中两种是标准做法，一种是在另一种的修正中。当前使用的扩展统计分配了一个从未训练过的模型Transition-level auditing is the right response to the fact that accuracy conceals what a self-improving model gains and what it destroys. It is also a measurement problem in its own right: we isolate seven ways to get it wrong, two of them standard practice and one inside the correction for another. The replicates that bound a null already exist in any multi-arm study, provided there are enough of them.

道德声明Ethics Statement

这项研究在公共数学基准上评估语言模型，并仅发布关于这些问题的模型生成的文本；它不涉及人类主体，也不涉及个人数据。有两个方面值得评论。第一个是域外拒绝探测。它的提示故意是温和的和非操作性的，询问有害行为的形式而不是执行该行为的手段，因为它们的目的是引起拒绝而不是任何可用的东西。探针被发布，以便其结果可以根据我们以外的规则重新评分。这一结果支持的是一个界限，而不是一个许可：我们拒绝声称自我训练不会造成安全侵蚀，并且数据既没有影响，也与实际规模一致（附录This study evaluates language models on public mathematics benchmarks and releases only model-generated text about those problems; it involves no human subjects and no personal data. Two aspects warrant comment. The first is the out-of-domain refusal probe. Its prompts are deliberately mild and non-operational, asking for the shape of a harmful action rather than the means to carry one out, because their purpose is to elicit a refusal and not anything usable. The probe is released so that its result can be re-scored under a rule other than ours. What that result supports is a bound and not a clearance: we decline to claim that self-training causes no safety erosion here, and the data are consistent both with no effect and with one of practical size (AppendixD.4）。本文中的任何内容都不应被视为证明自我训练方法在没有监督的情况下可以安全部署的证据。其次，本文报告了其记录的每种故障模式，包括非受控分析支持的结论以及排除该模式的控制的边际成本。呈现两者都是经过深思熟虑的：从未重新测量零值的文献正是本文所要讨论的失败之处。蒸馏控制使用在其许可条款内公开发布的教师，以及附录). Nothing in this paper should be read as evidence that a self-training method is safe to deploy without supervision. The second is that this paper reports, for every failure mode it documents, both the conclusion an uncontrolled analysis supports and the marginal cost of the control that rules it out. Presenting both is deliberate: a literature in which nulls are never re-measured is precisely the failure this paper is about. The distillation control uses an openly released teacher within the terms of its license, and AppendixA.4完整报告该研究的计算和货币成本。reports the study’s compute and monetary cost in full.

Every number and figure in this paper is a function of those counts and is recomputed from them by released code; none is transcribed by hand. The evaluation subsets are released with the code, including the constructed difficulty band and the selection profile used to build it, together with the noise-floor runs for each benchmark. Section3和附录and AppendixA.1完整说明训练和采样配置，包括温度、顶部state the training and sampling configuration in full, including temperature, top-pp、令牌上限、学习率、适配器排名和每轮训练示例计数。审计的方法是针对 Tinker 的重新实现, token caps, learning rate, adapter rank and per-round training-example counts. The audited methods are reimplementations against Tinker11 1 https://thinkingmachines.ai/tinker/，托管的 LoRA 培训和采样服务已发布；策略梯度臂使用该服务的重要性抽样目标来衡量以群体为中心的优势，以群体均值作为基线，在每轮的单个时期之外没有剪裁和非政策修正。, a hosted LoRA training and sampling service, and are released; the policy-gradient arm uses that service’s importance-sampling objective on group-centered advantages, with the group mean as baseline, no clipping and no off-policy correction beyond a single epoch per round.

大型语言模型的使用Use of Large Language Models

基于法学硕士的编码助手用于实施评估工具、运行和监控实验，并协助语言编辑和校对。本文中的所有实验设计决策、所有结果解释以及所有声明均属于作者自己。报告的每个数字都是根据已发布的每个样本记录中的已发布代码计算得出的；没有一个是由语言模型产生或转录的。An LLM-based coding assistant was used to implement the evaluation harness and to run and monitor experiments, and assist with language editing and proofreading. All experimental design decisions, all interpretation of results, and all claims in this paper are the authors’ own. Every number reported is computed by released code from released per-sample records; none was produced or transcribed by a language model.

附录AAppendix A实验方案和实施细节Experimental protocols and implementation details

本附录修复了研究中每个手臂和每一代的运行情况：训练和采样配置（§This appendix fixes what every arm and every generation in the study was run under: the training and sampling configuration (§A.1）、完成通过的提示和评分规则（§), the prompt and the grading rules a completion passed through (§A.2），政策梯度目标及其三个种子（§), the policy-gradient objective and its three seeds (§A.3），以及研究消耗的计算量（§), and the compute the study consumed (§A.4).

A.1 训练和采样配置Training and sampling configuration

提示。The prompt.

本研究中的每一代，无论是评估还是进化流，都使用一个模板，没有少数样本，也没有系统消息：Every generation in this study, for evaluation and for the evolution stream alike, uses one template with no few-shot examples and no system message:

解决以下数学问题。一步步推理，然后在 \boxed{} 中给出最终答案。Solve the following math problem. Reason step by step, then give your final answer inside \boxed{}.
问题：{问题}Problem: {problem}
解决方案：Solution:

问题字符串未经修改地传递，包括任何 Asymptote 图源，这就是为什么某些 MATH-500 几何项目在上下文中包含图表列表的原因。在这里，将提示固定在手臂和检查点上比选择一个好的提示更重要：过渡是两个评估之间的差异，因此它们之间的任何变化而不是模型都是令人困惑的。The problem string is passed through unmodified, including any Asymptote figure source, which is why some MATH-500 geometry items carry a diagram listing into the context. Holding the prompt fixed across arms and checkpoints matters more here than choosing a good one: a transition is a difference between two evaluations, so anything that changes between them and is not the model is a confound.

A.2 提示、评分和答案提取Prompting, grading and answer extraction

答案摘自Answers are extracted from\boxed{}如果存在，则来自明确的“答案是”结构，然后通过符号等价进行比较where present and from an explicit “the answer is” construction otherwise, then compared by symbolic equivalence(33)。我们故意拒绝实践中常见的第三种后备方法：采用补全中出现的最后一个数字。在截断推理中，启发式接近于抛硬币，其错误是. We deliberately reject a third fallback that is common in practice: taking the last number appearing in the completion. On truncated reasoning that heuristic is close to a coin flip, and its errors are随机的random而不是系统化的。随机正确性对转换指标的损害远大于统一的严格性：系统性严格的评分者会降低每个检查点的准确性，并在很大程度上消除差异，而抽签则无缘无故地在状态之间转移问题，并被视为学习或腐败。在一次试点运行中提供了后备rather than systematic. Random correctness is far more damaging to a transition metric than uniform strictness: a systematically strict grader lowers accuracy at every checkpoint and largely cancels in the difference, whereas a lottery moves problems between states for no reason and is counted as learning or corruption. On one pilot run the fallback supplied78%78\%所有提取的答案。of all extracted answers.

截断与此直接交互，即F3。达到代币上限的完成没有最终答案，并且被评级为不正确，如果速率在检查点之间稳定则无害，如果不稳定则严重（表Truncation interacts with this directly, which is F3. A completion that hits the token cap has no final answer and is graded incorrect, harmless if the rate is stable across checkpoints and severe if it is not (Table4）。我们还跟踪哪个提取路径产生了每个答案，因为停止发出的方法). We also track which extraction path produced each answer, since a method that stops emitting\boxed{}否则将被记录为能力损失。would otherwise register as capability loss.

A.3 多数票奖励的政策梯度Policy gradient on a majority-vote reward

为什么手臂存在。Why the arm exists.

主要审计的两个自我训练部分都是拒绝采样 SFT：它们保留过滤器接受的内容并丢弃其余的，而发布的 TTRL 则将丢失的样本压低。将自己定位于强化学习文献，然后仅测量监督微调的审计是在审计其他东西，因此我们运行了真正的文章：在训练服务的重要性抽样损失和以群体为中心的优势下，在同一流和相同的多数投票上的群体相对政策梯度。Both self-training arms of the main audit are rejection-sampling SFT: they keep what their filter accepts and discard the rest, where TTRL as published pushes the losing samples down instead. An audit that positions itself against a reinforcement-learning literature and then measures only supervised fine-tuning is auditing something else, so we ran the genuine article: a group-relative policy gradient on the same stream and the same majority vote, under the training service’s importance-sampling loss with group-centered advantages.

在乐队上它表现得很好；在 AIME 上它无法生存。On the band it behaves; on AIME it does not survive.

我们列出小的非零计数而不是将它们四舍五入。它们是无与伦比的比较所隐藏的东西：应用于它实际上可以解决的一系列问题时，自我训练偶尔确实会提出一个罕见的问题，超越噪音。它的速度是老师的五分之一；方向不变，转移的数量是一个比率，而不是绝对的“从不”。由于 F3 预测的原因，这种比较也是保守的，老师不赞成：蒸馏臂截断We state the small non-zero counts rather than round them away. They are what an unmatched comparison hides: applied to a stream of problems it can actually solve, self-training does occasionally raise a rarely-reached problem above the noise. It does so at a fifth of the teacher’s rate; the direction is unchanged, and the quantity that transfers is a rate rather than a categorical “never”.
